Product Portfolio

Products

We specify, source, and support the right products for every K-12 security challenge — from a single door to a multi-campus district.

Soulard Technology is manufacturer-agnostic. We recommend products based on your budget, facility layout, and security goals — not on vendor relationships.

What We Offer

Product Categories

Access Control Panels

The intelligence at the heart of every access control system. We spec and deploy controllers from Lenel, Software House, Genetec, and other leading platforms — scaled from single-door to enterprise-wide.

  • Single & multi-door controllers
  • IP-based & hybrid panels
  • Failsafe / fail-secure configurations
  • Battery backup & power supervision

Card Readers & Credentials

From proximity cards to mobile credentials, we deploy the full spectrum of reader technologies — selecting the right credential type for each facility's threat level and budget.

  • HID, ASSA ABLOY & Allegion readers
  • Mobile & BLE credentials
  • Multi-technology readers
  • Smart card (MIFARE, DESFire)

Door Hardware & Locking

Electric strikes, magnetic locks, electrified hardware, and door position switches — we design locking systems that meet life-safety codes while delivering reliable access control.

  • Electric strikes & mag locks
  • Electrified panic hardware
  • Door position & REX sensors
  • ADA-compliant hardware

Intercoms & Video Entry

IP video intercoms at every entry point give staff visual confirmation before granting access — an essential layer for K-12 visitor management.

  • IP video intercoms
  • Door station cameras
  • Two-way audio
  • Integration with access control

Visitor Management

Purpose-built visitor management platforms that screen guests, print badges, and sync with your access control system — keeping unvetted visitors from roaming freely.

  • Sex offender screening
  • Driver's license scanning
  • Temporary badge printing
  • Watch-list alerts

Security Management Software

The software layer that ties everything together — scheduling, reporting, lockdown commands, and integrations with video surveillance and intrusion detection.

  • Lenel OnGuard
  • Software House CCURE 9000
  • Genetec Security Center
  • Cloud-managed platforms
